reason: Playwright's page.routeWebSocket is a page-level route, and it takes precedence over the context's routes. Strider routes WebSockets only on a browser context (UserContext.routeWebSocket), so the page's own route, and which of the two wins, can't be expressed
A context's baseURL resolves a relative WebSocket route pattern ("/ws") against the page's origin; Strider's context options have no baseURL, so a relative pattern has no origin to resolve against
